evals.prompt: 我对当前工作区的 Web SaaS 账单协作系统还没做过任何 bug 排查，帮我做一次全面产品体检，重点从实际用户闭环、状态流转、权限边界和异常韧性角度反查有没有设计缺陷或功能 bug，先出可直接交给修复规划的缺陷清单，不要改代码。
evals.expected_output: Classifies Web/SaaS shape and Entry B (zero-prerequisite), reads source surfaces across UI/routes/handlers/models/auth/boundaries, runs all 8 abstract lenses in references/defect-lenses.md, filters false positives with references/evidence-and-filtering.md, labels fact vs inference, stays strictly read-only, and outputs calibrated AUDIT-NNN findings with Verification Criteria.
assertions: Catches cross-tenant IDOR on GET /api/invoices/:id (requireAuth without workspace_id check)
Does NOT false-positive report DELETE /api/invoices/:id as missing authZ (guarded by requireWorkspaceAdmin)
Catches illegal state transition in cancelInvoice (no paid/cancelled check) and silent webhook failure/verification gap
Catches InvoiceForm.jsx missing in-flight double-submit lock + input wipe, plus float price calculation / lazy WEBHOOK_SIGNING_SECRET crash
Includes structured Audit Summary, Severity rationale, Evidence [fact/inference], Verification Criteria, and Scope Guardrail

evals.prompt: 我们现在已经整理了两个已知 bug（B-001 导出任务失败后列表仍显示完成；B-002 普通成员能通过 URL 访问管理员计费页），请在此基础上再深度反查一遍项目源码，看看同一条链路或其他核心流程里还有没有遗漏的功能 bug 或设计缺陷，注意和已有问题去重，别改动源文件。
evals.expected_output: Selects Entry A (incremental deduplicated audit), uses B-001 and B-002 as baseline, traces actual handlers/middlewares/state transitions, omits exact duplicates in Findings while documenting sibling-of links and already-tracked exclusions under Deduplicated Against Known Bugs, and outputs verification-ready AUDIT-NNN entries without editing code.
assertions: Does NOT re-report B-001 or B-002 as duplicate net-new AUDIT findings; records deduplication explicitly
Finds sibling-of:B-001 in exports.py retry_export/run_export_worker (resets running status + appends partial file)
Finds sibling-of:B-002 in admin_billing.py update_billing_plan (UI-only gating without server-side admin check)
Finds net-new cascade defect in projects.py delete_project (orphan scheduled_exports/exports without cleanup)
Provides file:line evidence, fact/inference separation, calibrated Severity + rationale, and Verification Criteria

evals.prompt: 这是一个纯 CLI + 后台配置同步的开发者工具仓库，没有前端页面也没有启动服务。请反查它在配置校验、冷启动、超时与部分失败恢复、命令交互顺手度上有没有产品功能或设计缺陷。
evals.expected_output: Classifies CLI/Dev Tool shape, gracefully marks static source audit only (no live walkthrough), adapts lenses to skip interactive visual UI checklists while thoroughly checking verification-blind-spot, flow-dead-end, CLI ergonomic-friction-defect, boundary resilience, idempotent re-runs, and fail-fast startup config readiness.
assertions: Adapts to CLI / Dev Tool shape: skips UI/React checklists and explicitly states static source audit only (no live run)
Catches missing network timeout on urllib.request.urlopen in syncer.py
Catches mid-loop partial file overwrite without rollback or per-target summary in syncer.py
Catches exit code 0 on failure + swallowed error diagnostics in cli.py AND cold-start crash on missing config in config.py
Remains read-only and outputs Verification Criteria plus Scope Guardrail per finding
